episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis:
Nadeshiko hears a complex lie about soba udon from Aoi, who also has her younger sister, Akari, in on it as well.

There are many Rin doppelgängers that fool Nadeshiko to the point where she needs to text the real one.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis:
After jumping out of a plane, the Outdoor Activities Club members become stranded on a desert island.

Rin assumes fishing duties and catches some large ones. Both Nadeshiko and Chiaki adapt to the scenario in a different manner.
